phrase.zh: 换一种时空观，重问熟悉的世界。
phrase.en: A new view of spacetime reshapes familiar questions.

visual.zh: 爱因斯坦的生成肖像与交织曲线把思想人物和时空概念并置。肖像不是照片，线条也不是从相对论方程计算出的物理模拟。
visual.en: A generated portrait of Einstein meets interwoven curves to connect a thinker with spacetime. The portrait is not a photograph, and the lines are not a simulation calculated from relativity.

background.zh: NASA 的科学史文章区分了爱因斯坦 1905 年的狭义相对论与 1915 年完成关键工作的广义相对论。前者改变了绝对时间和空间的观念，后者用时空几何描述引力。两个理论并不是同一年提出，也不能把所有现代物理都概括为一个公式。
background.en: NASA distinguishes Einstein’s 1905 special relativity from the crucial 1915 development of general relativity. The former changed ideas of absolute space and time; the latter described gravity through spacetime geometry. These were distinct developments, not one theory produced in a single year.
